definition: [ שָׁדַד ] 56 verb deal violently with, despoil, devastate, ruin (Late Hebrew id. , Niph`al; Arabic stop up, obstruct, arrest, make firm ; Ethiopic expel ; Assyrian šadâdu is draw, drag ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural consecutive וְשָֽׁדְדוּ Ezek 32:12 suffix שַׁדּוּנִי Ps 17:9 Imperfect 3 masculine singular יָשׁוּד (metaplastic, compare Ges «GKC:67q»§ 67q Bae ) Ps 91:6 suffix יְשָׁדֵּם ( Ges «GKC:67n»§ 67n ) Prov 11:3 Qr ( Kt Perfect ושׁדם ), יְשָׁדְדֵם Jer 5:6 Imperative masculine plural שָׁדְדו ( Ges «GKC:67cc»§ 67cc ) Jer 49:28 Infinitive absolute שָׁדוֺד Mic 2:4 construct לִשְׁדוֺד Jer 47:4 ( Ges «GKC:45g»§ 45g ), compare also שֹׁד Hos 10:14 Participle active שֹׁדֵד Jer 6:26 +,etc.; pass . שָׁדוּד Judg 5:27 +, feminine שְׁדוּדָה Ps 137:8 — violently destory , person, = slay Judg 5:27 (passive), Jer 5:6 (wolf subject; || הִכָּה ); accusative Philistines Jer 47:4 (|| הִכְרִית ), v Jer 47:4 (subject ׳ י ); = devastate , accusative בָּבֶל (subject ׳ י ) Jer 51:55 , compare Ps 137:8 (read probably הַשֹּׁדֵדָה We Du , compare Ew Hi הַשָּׁדוֺדָה see Kö ii.194 ); אֶתגְּֿאוֺן מִצְרַיִם Ezek 32:12 (|| נִשְׁמַד ), compare Hos 10:14 , אֶתמַֿרְעִיתָם Jer 25:36 (subject ׳ י ), absolute Isa 21:2 (|| בָּגַד ), Isa 33:1 (on use of pt see Ges «GKC:120b»§ 120b ), pass v Isa 33:1 (|| בָּגַד ), אַתְּי שָׁדוּד Jer 4:30 ( Gf Ba NB 179 , but dubious; < Du שְׁדוּדָה ); = despoil , accusative of person Jer 49:28 = bring person to ruin Mic 2:4 (Infinitive absolute + Niph`al q. v.), Prov 11:3 weaker, assail Ps 17:9 elsewhere Participle active as substantive devastator (despoiler?) : of national foes Isa 16:4 ; Isa 21:2 ; Isa 33:1 ; Jer 6:26 + 8 t. Jeremiah; שׁוֺדְדֵי לַיְלָה Obad 1:5 (|| גַּנָּבִים ) strike out Now GASm ; personal foe Job 15:21 representing wicked in general Job 12:6 (|| מַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל ). Niph`al Perfect 1 plural שָׁדוֺד נְשַׁדֻּנוּ ( Ges «GKC:67u»§ 67u Kö i. 342 f. ) we are utterly ruined. Pi`el Imperfect 2 masculine singular אַלתְּֿשַׁדֵּד רִבְצוֺ Prov 24:15 assault not his dwelling-place (|| אַלאֱֶֿרֹב ); Participle as substantive מְשַׁדֶּדאָֿב Prov 19:26 he who assaults, maltreats (his) father (|| יַבְרִיחַ אֵם ). Pu`al Perfect 3 masculine singular שֻׁדַּד Isa 15:1 +, 3 feminine singular שֻׁדְּדָה Jer 4:20 +, שָׁדְּדָה Nah 3:7 ( Ges «GKC:52q»§ 52q ), etc.; — be devastated , of city Isa 15:1 (twice in verse); Isa 23:1 ; Jer 48:1 ; Jer 49:3 ; Nah 3:7 , country or nation Jer 4:20 , compare v Jer 4:13 ; Jer 9:18 ; Jer 48:15 ; Jer 48:20 ; Jer 49:10 , dwellings ( אֹהֶל ) Jer 4:20 ; Jer 10:20 , trees Zech 11:2 (strike out Sta ZAW 1 (1881), 25 ), compare v Zech 11:33 , stength of ships Isa 23:14 , field (by drought) Joel 1:10 , crop v Joel 1:10 . Po`l. violently destroy: Imperfect 3 masculine singular יְשֹׁרֵד מַצֵּבוֺתָם Hos 10:2 (|| יַעֲרֹף מִוְבְּחֹתָם ). Hoph`al Imperfect (or Qal passive Imperfect? compare Ges «GKC:53u»§ 53u ) be devastated: 3 masculine singular כָּלמִֿבְצָרֶיךָ יוּשָּׁ֑ד Hos 10:14 (of Ephraim, < We plural יושׁדו ); 2 masculine singular תּוּשַּׁד Isa 33:1 (subject שׁוֺדֵד , see Qal ).
